_comment: Client-side Battle Pass season calendar. Season 1 mirrors the server window (battlePassStartDate/battlePassEndDate in config.lua): 63 days, separated by a 60-day gap. The client derives the active season locally from the current system time so the UI no longer depends on a server opcode to know when to show the button.

mission_unlock._comment: Mirrors the server schedule on plain 7-day weeks: week 1 exposes 4 missions, and new missions unlock every 7 days from the season start. The exact per-week counts are non-linear (see BattlePass.getExposedMissionCount), so only the cadence is described here. Missions that have not unlocked yet are ignored by progress counters.
